Desktop OS.reason: Illustrator contains an improper input validation flaw leading to arbitrary code execution, making it a high-value target for malicious file distribution campaigns targeting creative professionals.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Illustrator contains an improper input validation flaw leading to arbitrary code execution, making it a high-value target for malicious file distribution campaigns targeting creative professionals.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Illustrator 存在输入验证不当缺陷，可导致任意代码执行，使其成为针对创意专业人士的恶意文件分发活动的高价值目标。

Desktop OS.reason: A use-after-free vulnerability in Acrobat Reader enables remote code execution upon opening crafted documents, posing significant risks in corporate email and document sharing workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in Acrobat Reader enables remote code execution upon opening crafted documents, posing significant risks in corporate email and document sharing workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Acrobat Reader 中的释放后使用漏洞可在打开特制文档时导致远程代码执行，在企业邮件和文档共享工作流中构成重大风险。

Desktop OS.reason: Out-of-bounds write in Acrobat Reader enables arbitrary code execution when users open malicious PDFs, posing a significant threat due to the application's ubiquity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Acrobat Reader enables arbitrary code execution when users open malicious PDFs, posing a significant threat due to the application's ubiquity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Acrobat Reader 中的越界写入漏洞在用户打开恶意 PDF 时可导致任意代码执行，由于该应用普及率高，构成重大威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in InDesign Desktop allows RCE upon opening crafted files, targeting creative professionals who frequently handle untrusted assets.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in InDesign Desktop allows RCE upon opening crafted files, targeting creative professionals who frequently handle untrusted assets.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: InDesign Desktop 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞在打开特制文件时可导致远程代码执行（RCE），主要面向经常处理不受信任素材的创意专业人士。

Desktop OS.reason: Incorrect authorization in Lightroom Classic permits arbitrary code execution, potentially compromising user workspaces and sensitive photographic data.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Lightroom Classic permits arbitrary code execution, potentially compromising user workspaces and sensitive photographic data.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Lightroom Classic 中的授权不正确漏洞允许任意代码执行，可能危及用户工作区及敏感摄影数据。

Desktop OS.reason: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Substance3D Designer leads to RCE, requiring exploitation of user interaction with malicious design files.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Substance3D Designer leads to RCE, requiring exploitation of user interaction with malicious design files.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Substance3D Designer 中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行（RCE），需利用用户与恶意设计文件的交互进行攻击。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Adobe Illustrator enables arbitrary code execution when users open crafted files, representing a high-risk threat to desktop workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Adobe Illustrator enables arbitrary code execution when users open crafted files, representing a high-risk threat to desktop workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Adobe Illustrator 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞在用户打开特制文件时可导致任意代码执行，对桌面工作站构成高风险威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free flaw in Acrobat Reader allows remote code execution upon opening malicious PDFs, directly impacting end-user desktop environments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in Acrobat Reader allows remote code execution upon opening malicious PDFs, directly impacting end-user desktop environments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Acrobat Reader 中的释放后使用缺陷可在打开恶意 PDF 时允许远程代码执行，直接影响终端用户的桌面环境。

Desktop OS.reason: A heap-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI+ allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code or escalate privileges by exploiting memory corruption in a core graphics subsystem.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI+ allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code or escalate privileges by exploiting memory corruption in a core graphics subsystem.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows GDI+ 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地攻击者通过利用核心图形子系统中的内存损坏来执行任意代码或提升权限。

Desktop OS.reason: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in .NET enables unauthorized local code execution, posing a direct threat to desktop environments relying on managed runtime environments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in .NET enables unauthorized local code execution, posing a direct threat to desktop environments relying on managed runtime environments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: .NET 中的越界写入漏洞可启用未授权的本地代码执行，对依赖托管运行时的桌面环境构成直接威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel can be triggered by malicious documents, allowing local attackers to execute code and compromise end-user workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel can be triggered by malicious documents, allowing local attackers to execute code and compromise end-user workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可由恶意文档触发，使本地攻击者能够执行代码并破坏终端用户工作站。

Desktop OS.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office allows local code execution. Its high prevalence makes it a prime target for phishing campaigns delivering malicious documents.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office allows local code execution. Its high prevalence makes it a prime target for phishing campaigns delivering malicious documents.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Office 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地代码执行。其高发性使其成为投递恶意文档的网络钓鱼活动的重点目标。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Word enables unauthorized local code execution via crafted files. This poses a significant risk to end-users opening untrusted attachments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Word enables unauthorized local code execution via crafted files. This poses a significant risk to end-users opening untrusted attachments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过特制文件实现未授权的本地代码执行。这对打开不受信任附件的终端用户构成重大风险。

Desktop OS.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution over a network. Attackers can exploit this to gain full control of targeted endpoints without user interaction.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution over a network. Attackers can exploit this to gain full control of targeted endpoints without user interaction.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。攻击者可利用此漏洞在无需用户交互的情况下完全控制目标端点。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Kerberos allows local privilege escalation. Compromising this service grants attackers domain-level administrative access.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Kerberos allows local privilege escalation. Compromising this service grants attackers domain-level administrative access.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地权限提升。攻破该服务将使攻击者获得域级管理员访问权限。

Desktop OS.reason: Improper link resolution in the Accessibility Infrastructure enables local privilege escalation with a notably high EPSS score (0.0368). This indicates strong real-world exploitation potential against accessibility features.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Improper link resolution in the Accessibility Infrastructure enables local privilege escalation with a notably high EPSS score (0.0368). This indicates strong real-world exploitation potential against accessibility features.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Accessibility Infrastructure 中的链接解析不当漏洞可导致本地权限提升，且 EPSS 评分显著偏高（0.0368）。这表明针对辅助功能特性的实际利用潜力较强。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in Win32K allows authorized users to escalate privileges locally. As a core graphics subsystem component, it remains a frequent target for kernel exploits.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Win32K allows authorized users to escalate privileges locally. As a core graphics subsystem component, it remains a frequent target for kernel exploits.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Win32K 中的释放后使用漏洞允许授权用户进行本地权限提升。作为核心图形子系统组件，它仍是内核漏洞利用的常见目标。

Desktop OS.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel allows unauthorized local code execution, posing a direct threat to end-user workstations through malicious documents.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel allows unauthorized local code execution, posing a direct threat to end-user workstations through malicious documents.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的本地代码执行，通过恶意文档对终端用户工作站构成直接威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free in Windows Deployment Services with a CVSS of 9.8 enables remote code execution without authentication, severely impacting enterprise deployment infrastructure.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Deployment Services with a CVSS of 9.8 enables remote code execution without authentication, severely impacting enterprise deployment infrastructure.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中的释放后使用漏洞（CVSS 评分为 9.8）可实现无需认证的远程代码执行，严重影响企业部署基础设施。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Installer can be leveraged by attackers to escalate privileges locally during routine software installation processes.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Installer can be leveraged by attackers to escalate privileges locally during routine software installation processes.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Installer 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可被攻击者在常规软件安装过程中利用，以实现本地权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: High-severity heap overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution via malicious web content, posing a direct threat to end-user systems.
Desktop OS.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution via malicious web content, posing a direct threat to end-user systems.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的高危堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意网页内容实现远程代码执行，对终端用户系统构成直接威胁。

Desktop OS.reason: Kernel-level buffer overflow allows local privilege escalation to SYSTEM level by exploiting memory corruption during file system operations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Kernel-level buffer overflow allows local privilege escalation to SYSTEM level by exploiting memory corruption during file system operations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 内核级缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过利用文件系统操作期间的内存损坏，实现向 SYSTEM 级别的本地权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Remote Desktop Client vulnerability permits unauthenticated network-based code execution, allowing attackers to compromise client machines without user interaction.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Remote Desktop Client vulnerability permits unauthenticated network-based code execution, allowing attackers to compromise client machines without user interaction.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 漏洞允许未经认证的网络代码执行，使攻击者能够在无需用户交互的情况下入侵客户端计算机。

Desktop OS.reason: Privilege escalation vulnerability in HP Easy Start for macOS could allow local attackers to gain elevated system permissions on widely deployed workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Privilege escalation vulnerability in HP Easy Start for macOS could allow local attackers to gain elevated system permissions on widely deployed workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: macOS 版 HP Easy Start 中的权限提升漏洞可能允许本地攻击者在广泛部署的工作站上获取提升的系统权限。

Desktop OS.reason: Stack buffer overflow in FFmpeg's MPEG-PS muxer triggers remote code execution when processing crafted media files containing excessive streams.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in FFmpeg's MPEG-PS muxer triggers remote code execution when processing crafted media files containing excessive streams.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: FFmpeg 的 MPEG-PS 复用器中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理包含过多流的特制媒体文件时会触发远程代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap buffer overflow in the libaom AV1 encoder's look-ahead processing mode allows arbitrary code execution via specially crafted video frames.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in the libaom AV1 encoder's look-ahead processing mode allows arbitrary code execution via specially crafted video frames.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: libaom AV1 编码器的预读处理模式中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过特制视频帧实现任意代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: The UI-TARS-desktop MCP server defaults to binding on all network interfaces without mandatory authentication, exposing local desktop AI services to remote exploitation.
Desktop OS.reason_en: The UI-TARS-desktop MCP server defaults to binding on all network interfaces without mandatory authentication, exposing local desktop AI services to remote exploitation.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: UI-TARS-desktop MCP 服务器默认绑定所有网络接口且无强制身份验证，导致本地桌面 AI 服务暴露于远程利用风险之下。

Desktop OS.reason: A buffer overflow in the WibuKey64.sys Windows driver allows out-of-bounds memory writes, which can trigger denial of service or potentially enable remote code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A buffer overflow in the WibuKey64.sys Windows driver allows out-of-bounds memory writes, which can trigger denial of service or potentially enable remote code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: WibuKey64.sys Windows 驱动程序中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许越界内存写入，可能触发拒绝服务或潜在地启用远程代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: A kernel driver write-what-where primitive allows local attackers to escalate privileges to administrator level.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A kernel driver write-what-where primitive allows local attackers to escalate privileges to administrator level.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 内核驱动程序的任意地址写原语允许本地攻击者将权限提升至管理员级别。

Desktop OS.reason: Modeline sandbox bypass in Vim enables arbitrary OS command execution when users open crafted text files.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Modeline sandbox bypass in Vim enables arbitrary OS command execution when users open crafted text files.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Vim 中的 Modeline 沙箱绕过漏洞在用户打开特制文本文件时可启用任意操作系统命令执行。

Desktop OS.reason: Symlink traversal in getfattr/setfattr utilities allows local privilege escalation by redirecting directory operations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Symlink traversal in getfattr/setfattr utilities allows local privilege escalation by redirecting directory operations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: getfattr/setfattr 工具中的符号链接遍历漏洞允许通过重定向目录操作实现本地权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap buffer overflow during XCOFF object file linking can be triggered locally to achieve arbitrary code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow during XCOFF object file linking can be triggered locally to achieve arbitrary code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 在 XCOFF 目标文件链接期间发生的堆缓冲区溢出可被本地触发，从而实现任意代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: Path traversal in TeamViewer allows authenticated participants to write files to arbitrary locations via file transfer or clipboard, compromising host integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Path traversal in TeamViewer allows authenticated participants to write files to arbitrary locations via file transfer or clipboard, compromising host integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: TeamViewer 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证参与者通过文件传输或剪贴板将文件写入任意位置，从而破坏主机完整性。

Mobile Security.reason: Path traversal flaw in Teams for Android allows unauthorized code execution by manipulating restricted directory paths, compromising mobile device isolation.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in Teams for Android allows unauthorized code execution by manipulating restricted directory paths, compromising mobile device isolation.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Android 版 Teams 中的路径遍历缺陷允许通过操纵受限目录路径实现未授权代码执行，破坏移动设备隔离性。

Mobile Security.reason: Unauthenticated broken access control in the WooCommerce mobile app exposes sensitive user data and transaction details.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated broken access control in the WooCommerce mobile app exposes sensitive user data and transaction details.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: WooCommerce 移动应用中未认证的访问控制失效漏洞会暴露敏感用户数据和交易详情。

IoT Security.reason: Authentication bypass in TP-Link Tapo smart cameras allows local attackers to seize administrative session tokens, directly compromising device privacy and physical security controls.
IoT Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in TP-Link Tapo smart cameras allows local attackers to seize administrative session tokens, directly compromising device privacy and physical security controls.
IoT Security.reason_zh: TP-Link Tapo 智能摄像头中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许本地攻击者窃取管理会话令牌，直接损害设备隐私与物理安全控制。

IoT Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the HTTP parser of Tapo cameras could destabilize firmware or potentially lead to code execution on resource-constrained edge devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the HTTP parser of Tapo cameras could destabilize firmware or potentially lead to code execution on resource-constrained edge devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Tapo 摄像头 HTTP 解析器中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可能导致固件不稳定，或在资源受限的边缘设备上引发代码执行。

IoT Security.reason: Exploitable out-of-bounds write in the Bluetooth Mesh SDK allows remote code execution on connected IoT devices, directly undermining mesh network integrity and device provisioning security.
IoT Security.reason_en: Exploitable out-of-bounds write in the Bluetooth Mesh SDK allows remote code execution on connected IoT devices, directly undermining mesh network integrity and device provisioning security.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Bluetooth Mesh SDK 中可利用的越界写入漏洞允许对已连接的物联网设备实施远程代码执行，直接破坏网状网络完整性与设备配置安全性。

IoT Security.reason: Authentication weakness in Xiiaozet LK100Wt allows attackers to bypass access controls and gain command execution, severely compromising IoT gateway security.
IoT Security.reason_en: Authentication weakness in Xiiaozet LK100Wt allows attackers to bypass access controls and gain command execution, severely compromising IoT gateway security.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Xiiaozet LK100Wt 的身份验证缺陷允许攻击者绕过访问控制并获取命令执行权限，严重损害物联网网关安全性。

IoT Security.reason: Unauthenticated invocation of administrative services on Xiiaozet LK100W devices permits remote attackers to enable restricted functionality and take full device control.
IoT Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated invocation of administrative services on Xiiaozet LK100W devices permits remote attackers to enable restricted functionality and take full device control.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 在 Xiiaozet LK100W 设备上未认证调用管理服务允许远程攻击者启用受限功能并完全控制设备。

IoT Security.reason: Improper certificate validation in the ASE2000 controller firmware allows remote attackers to bypass TLS security, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks and interception of sensitive operational commands.
IoT Security.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in the ASE2000 controller firmware allows remote attackers to bypass TLS security, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks and interception of sensitive operational commands.
IoT Security.reason_zh: ASE2000 控制器固件中证书验证不当的漏洞允许远程攻击者绕过 TLS 安全机制，实施中间人攻击并拦截敏感操作指令。

IoT Security.reason: Chained firmware weaknesses in Unitree robotics enable unauthenticated root RCE over the network, severely impacting physical safety and operational integrity.
IoT Security.reason_en: Chained firmware weaknesses in Unitree robotics enable unauthenticated root RCE over the network, severely impacting physical safety and operational integrity.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Unitree 机器人中的链式固件缺陷允许通过网络实现未认证的 Root 远程代码执行，严重影响物理安全与运行完整性。

IoT Security.reason: Improper input validation in FreeRTOS allows unprivileged tasks to escalate to kernel-level privileges on MPU-enabled embedded systems, compromising core device security.
IoT Security.reason_en: Improper input validation in FreeRTOS allows unprivileged tasks to escalate to kernel-level privileges on MPU-enabled embedded systems, compromising core device security.
IoT Security.reason_zh: FreeRTOS 中输入验证不当的漏洞允许非特权任务在支持 MPU 的嵌入式系统中提权至内核级权限，破坏核心设备安全性。

IoT Security.reason_en: Hardcoded FTP credentials combined with unrestricted file uploads in DJI drones enable complete device compromise and unauthorized firmware modifications.
IoT Security.reason_zh: DJI 无人机中硬编码的 FTP 凭据与无限制的文件上传相结合，可导致设备彻底沦陷及未授权的固件修改。

IoT Security.reason: A stack-based buffer overflow in the TOTOLINK router's CGI handler allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code and fully compromise the device.
IoT Security.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the TOTOLINK router's CGI handler allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code and fully compromise the device.

IoT Security.reason: Improper session validation in the ipTIME router bypasses authentication mechanisms, granting unauthorized remote access to network administrators and connected endpoints.
IoT Security.reason_en: Improper session validation in the ipTIME router bypasses authentication mechanisms, granting unauthorized remote access to network administrators and connected endpoints.
IoT Security.reason_zh: ipTIME 路由器中会话验证不当的漏洞会绕过身份验证机制，向未授权方授予对网络管理员及连接终端的远程访问权限。

IoT Security.reason: Firmware vulnerabilities in multiple Zbtlink router models allow remote attackers to gain unauthorized device control.
IoT Security.reason_en: Firmware vulnerabilities in multiple Zbtlink router models allow remote attackers to gain unauthorized device control.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 多款 Zbtlink 路由器型号的固件漏洞允许远程攻击者获取未授权的设备控制权。

IoT Security.reason: Stack buffer overflow in malicious NASL vulnerability test scripts can compromise security scanning appliances.
IoT Security.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in malicious NASL vulnerability test scripts can compromise security scanning appliances.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 恶意 NASL 漏洞测试脚本中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可能危及安全扫描设备。

Cloud Security.reason_en: Inadequate masking of cluster secrets exposes sensitive manager configuration data to low-privileged users, weakening security orchestration across cloud and endpoint workloads.

Cloud Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Campaign Classic enables RCE without user interaction, directly jeopardizing cloud-hosted marketing infrastructure.

Cloud Security.reason_en: OS command injection in ACC allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands remotely, leading to complete cloud environment compromise.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: ACC 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许攻击者远程执行任意系统命令，导致整个云环境沦陷。

Cloud Security.reason: Incorrect authorization flaw facilitates privilege escalation without user interaction, exposing sensitive campaign data and administrative controls.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization flaw facilitates privilege escalation without user interaction, exposing sensitive campaign data and administrative controls.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 授权错误缺陷可在无需用户交互的情况下促成权限提升，暴露敏感的活动数据与管理控制权限。
